headline: Automations, templates, share codes, and new maps
upgradeWarning: Back up before upgrading. The first boot turns every rule into an automation, with no going back to 2.1

highlights.title: Automations
highlights.body: Rules are automations now. Each one says what starts it: a stream event, an inactive account, a new device, a trust score change, a server going down or up, an update, or new media. The builder is one page (When, And only if, Then do) with a plain-words summary and a live check against what's playing.

highlights.title: Share codes
highlights.body: Export any automation as a `tracearr1.` code and paste it into another Tracearr. Tokens, ids, and server names are stripped, and imports start paused after showing what the code does.

highlights.title: Media triggers
highlights.body: Media added and media upgraded fire off library sync, ~30 s with Plex or the SSE plugin and next sync otherwise. Conditions on type, library, resolution, HDR, codec, audio, and file size. A library's first sync stays quiet.

highlights.title: Notifications
highlights.body: Settings → Notifications is a list of destinations: Discord, a JSON webhook, ntfy, Gotify, Apprise, Pushover, mobile push and browser toasts. Add more than one of a kind and pick events for each. Existing Discord, webhook, ntfy and Pushover settings move over on first boot, and webhook URLs and tokens are encrypted in the database.

changes.text: Activity opens on what automations ran, missed or failed, and any run replays into the builder
twenty-one ready-made automations in a gallery, pick one and fill in the blanks
a linked Plex account can be reauthorized from Settings when its token stops working
three update switches in Settings → General: SSE plugin, media servers, Tracearr
each destination subscription became an automation; fresh installs seed five
poster cache keeps one copy per poster and stops evicting unchanged ones
a failed notification retries three times before it parks in a dead-letter queue
maps run fully local with GPU acceleration, replacing the provider that changed its licensing
"is" on a list field accepts a single value, so old country rules save again
deleting a destination used inside an if branch is refused
episode and track notifications name the show or artist
rule push notifications carry the poster and user avatar again
v2 rule violations reach mobile push again
destination secrets are encrypted at rest with a key from `JWT_SECRET`, or `ENCRYPTION_KEY` if set
existing Discord, webhook, ntfy and Pushover settings move into destinations on first boot
